# Sandpile_Model

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A self-organized criticality model where nodes accumulate 'grains' and topple when exceeding a threshold, redistributing to neighbors. Provides a theoretical framework for understanding cascading dynamics and critical behavior in networked systems, relevant to fault propagation and load balancing in TCC/iNEST architectures.
